['Deutsche Telekom AG '].company_description: Deutsche Telekom AG is a German telecommunications company headquartered in Bonn. It is the largest telecommunications provider in Europe by revenue. The company operates several subsidiaries worldwide, including the mobile communications brand T-Mobile.

['Lidl Stiftung & Co. KG '].company_description: Lidl Stiftung & Co. KG is a German international discount retailer chain that operates over 12,000 stores across Europe and the United States. It is part of the Schwarz Group, which is the largest European retailer and the fourth-largest retailer in the world by revenue. Lidl is known for its private label brands and competes with Aldi in several markets. The company is headquartered in Neckarsulm, Baden-Württemberg, Germany.
